'''Mangy''' is a {{type|Cat}} [[enemy]] found primarily in {{ch|The Alley}}.

== Behavior ==
Ranged attacker that attempts to keep its distance while still keeping at least one of its enemies in range.

Its basic attack, <code>PoisonShot</code>, is a ranged lobbed attack that has a 25% chance to inflict {{st|Poison|#=1}}, in range of 2-3 tiles. {{RangeIndicatorWrapper|{{RangeIndicator|min_range=2|max_range=3}}}}

Summons a {{en|Maggot}} every time it is hit on an adjacent tile, save for the hit that kills it.
=== Tips ===
* Killing it with few attacks will reduce the amount of maggots it spawns.
* Reducing its {{stat|Luck}} will reduce the chance of the poison applying.
* Cannot attack units adjacent to it.

== Trivia ==
* They use the male4 [[voice]] for cats, voiced by Eryck Lindquist.
* Mangies are part of a small set of enemies that appear in all 3 Acts.
* Mangy is the base for 2 other enemies, being {{en|Mummified Mangy}} and {{en|Infested }}, whose internal names are <code>Mangy2</code> and <code>Mangy3</code> respectively.
* Despite their name referencing {{wikipedia|mange}}, Mangies do not have the effects of {{p|Mange}}.
